en.t: You always speak in such a roundabout way.

units.source_text: 真一微微一笑，声音却有些颤抖，

en.t: Shinichi smiled faintly, but his voice trembled a little,

units.source_text: 他把上身探出波形栏杆，想要偷看一眼千重子的脸。

en.t: he leaned his upper body out over the wavy railing, trying to steal a glimpse of Chieko's face.

units.source_text: “真想看看你这谜一般的弃儿的脸啊！”

en.t: I really want to see the face of this mysterious abandoned child that you are!
